post.summary: Model Context Protocol endpoint for CrowdStrike Falcon coverage lookups
post.description: A stateless MCP server over streamable HTTP, speaking JSON-RPC 2.0. Responses are always application/json; the server does not open a server-initiated SSE stream, so GET returns 405. Supported methods are initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, and notifications/* (accepted with 202 and no body). Tools: falcon_find_host, falcon_host_tags, falcon_unmanaged_on_subnet. MCP clients need no configuration beyond this URL — 3B runs the OAuth handshake at the route boundary.

method.description: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, or a notifications/* method.

oneOf.description: A JSON-RPC batch, accepted for clients on protocol versions that still send one.

200.description: A JSON-RPC response, or an array of them for a batch request.

result.description: Shape depends on the method. For tools/call it carries content[] and structuredContent, with isError true when the tool itself failed.

202.description: A notification was accepted. No body.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON.

405.description: The method is not POST. This endpoint offers no SSE stream.
